nodes.summary: Union-find with rank and path compression (including its connected-components application), link-cut trees and Euler-tour trees.
nodes.title: Disjoint sets and dynamic trees

nodes.summary: Hash tables (chaining, open addressing, cuckoo, perfect), universal hash families and Bloom filters including their false-positive analysis.
nodes.title: Hashing

nodes.summary: Priority queues: binary, d-ary, binomial, Fibonacci and catenable heaps, indexed min-queues, and their sift, decrease-key and merge operations and costs.
nodes.title: Heaps and priority queues

nodes.summary: Sequential containers and their amortized costs: linked lists (singly, doubly, sentinel), stacks with multipop, queues, deques, dynamic tables, binary counters, LRU caches, and generic list operations (ordered insertion, splitting, chunking, inclusive prefixes) that support them.
nodes.title: Lists, stacks, queues and dynamic arrays

nodes.summary: Structures answering range, interval or nearest-point queries: segment trees, Fenwick trees, sparse tables, interval trees, range trees, kd-trees, ball trees and fractional cascading.
nodes.title: Range-query and spatial structures

nodes.summary: Ordered dictionaries: binary search trees and their balanced variants (AVL, red-black, 2-3, B-trees, splay, treaps, weight-balanced, Cartesian, order-statistic) and skip lists, including their insertion and deletion procedures.
nodes.title: Search trees and skip lists

nodes.summary: Prefix- and bit-indexed structures: tries, radix (Patricia) tries, suffix arrays and suffix trees, van Emde Boas trees, x-fast and y-fast tries.
nodes.title: Tries, suffix structures and integer dictionaries

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
